answer: Endorsement weight is earned, not owned. Each epoch the protocol buries graded answers in each queue as a sealed test; a ballot counts only as accurately as that member judged those unseen items. A new key starts at zero authority: a thousand wallets run by one operator weigh nothing. Farming needs real grading skill per fake identity, sustained each epoch; guessing never clears the threshold. Colluders cannot whisper one verdict down the thread: assignments differ per key, near-identical reasoning is flagged as pigment from one brush. Attack cost is repeated judgment, not headcount.
